about: Free tiers, credit programs and openly licensed assets Verse may use, with the terms that allow it and where each fact was read. Kept by the free-resources guard (tools/guards/free.mjs), which runs inside the house lanes. It routes work to a free allowance with room before treasury money, and never signs up, never touches a payment step, and never uses a licence that does not allow it.
rules: use only what the terms allow
create no accounts and never touch payment details; a program that needs a sign-up is listed as needs sign-up for Atom
one legitimate account per service; no stacking
status is in use, available or needs sign-up; an ended offer moves to ended

entries.name: Cloudflare Workers AI free allocation
entries.what: 10,000 Neurons a day at no charge, reset 00:00 UTC; past it needs Workers Paid. A few models (Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek V4) need a paid method and are never used on the free path.
entries.license: Cloudflare Workers AI terms (service allowance, no resale)
entries.note: Verse already routes every model call through lib/models.js on this allowance first.

entries.name: Open models hosted on Workers AI
entries.what: Gemma, gpt-oss, Llama, Whisper, MeloTTS, FLUX and others run on the same free allocation; no key, no sign-up beyond the bound account.
entries.license: Per model: Gemma Terms of Use (Gemma), Apache-2.0 (gpt-oss), Llama Community License (Llama). Each model page states its own.
entries.note: Used within each licence; no model is retrained or redistributed.

entries.name: GitHub Actions on a public repository
entries.what: Standard GitHub-hosted runners are free in public repositories (void-loop is public, MIT), so every house lane, test and deploy runs at no charge.
entries.license: GitHub Terms, Actions billing: standard runners in public repos are free; larger runners are billed
entries.note: Larger runners are billed, so no workflow asks for one.

entries.name: Cloudflare Pages, Workers, D1 and Assets free plan
entries.what: Free plan limits cover Verse's hosting, D1 database and edge functions today (100,000 requests a day on Workers Free).
entries.license: Cloudflare Terms of Service, free plan limits
entries.verified: carried from resources/free.json, limits page not re-read

entries.name: Groq free plan
entries.what: Per model, no card: gpt-oss-120b and 20b and Qwen 3.8 27B at 30 requests a minute, 1,000 a day, 200K tokens a day; Whisper v3 at 2,000 requests a day. Limits are per organization.
entries.license: Groq console terms; data handling per Groq privacy policy
entries.needs: One free Groq account and one API key, added by Atom as GROQ_API_KEY. Once set, lib/free-router.js uses it when the Workers AI share is used up.

entries.name: Google Gemini API free tier
entries.what: Free tier for Flash-class models with per-model limits shown in AI Studio (reset midnight Pacific). Rate limits are per project.
entries.license: Gemini API Additional Terms: free-tier prompts may be used to improve Google products, so never send visitor data
entries.needs: One Google account and an AI Studio key, added by Atom as GEMINI_API_KEY.
entries.note: Exact daily numbers are in the logged-in AI Studio page only; the router uses a conservative share.

entries.name: OpenRouter free models
entries.what: Models whose id ends in :free: 20 requests a minute and 50 a day (1,000 a day only after buying credit, which Verse will not do).
entries.license: OpenRouter terms; each free provider sets its own data policy, keep the training toggle off
entries.needs: One OpenRouter account and a key, added by Atom as OPENROUTER_API_KEY, with the privacy toggle for training providers off.

entries.name: Cloudflare for Startups
entries.what: Tier 3 is $10k in credits for a bootstrapped company with a for-profit business, a business email on its own domain, a live site and a GitHub or X presence, for one year. Higher tiers need affiliated-partner funding. New startups: Workers AI is NOT covered by the credits from Dec 1, and AI Gateway is not covered for now.
entries.license: Cloudflare Startup Program terms; first-time applicants only; at Cloudflare's discretion
entries.needs: Atom applies for the company (business identity and a domain email). No agent applies.
entries.note: Covers Pages, Workers, D1, R2 up to $10k and similar: useful, but it does not pay for model calls.

entries.name: AWS Cloud Credits for Open Source Projects
entries.what: Promotional credits for compute, storage, database and test infrastructure. Needs an OSI-approved licence (void-loop is MIT), a project not dominated by one vendor or VC-funded, and active maintenance. AWS favours projects that complement AWS.
entries.license: AWS Promotional Credit Terms; issued monthly, none in December
entries.needs: Atom completes the AWS Open Source Credits application and emails it to awsopensourcecredits@amazon.com.
entries.note: Verse runs on Cloudflare, so credits would only pay for extras (an extra region of batch compute).

entries.name: Openverse images and audio
entries.what: Search API over openly licensed work, used through lib/free-pics.js: CC0, public domain, CC BY and CC BY-SA only, with the author, licence and source line shown; non-commercial, no-derivatives, unknown and all-rights-reserved are refused.
entries.license: Per work: CC0 and public domain need nothing; CC BY and CC BY-SA need the credit line (rendered with each picture); NC, ND and unknown are never used
entries.note: Each picture carries its own credit line, built by lib/free-pics.js. Optional OPENVERSE_CLIENT_ID and OPENVERSE_CLIENT_SECRET raise the limits.

entries.name: Pollinations image generation
entries.what: Open-source image generator; functions/api/card-art.js already tries the anonymous endpoint, and a free account key if POLLINATIONS_KEY is set. The current limits are on a page that needs JavaScript and could not be read.
entries.license: Pollinations terms (read them before adding a key)
entries.needs: Atom reads the terms at enter.pollinations.ai, and adds a key as POLLINATIONS_KEY only if they allow it.

entries.name: Open-weight models on Hugging Face
entries.what: Free to download and run: Apache-2.0, MIT, BSD and CC0 models can be used commercially. Llama and Gemma carry their own terms; any non-commercial licence (cc-by-nc and similar) is never used.
entries.license: Per model; the Hub lists the licence on each card
entries.note: A source of weights and datasets only. Serving them costs compute, which Workers AI covers for the models it hosts.

entries.name: Hugging Face ZeroGPU Spaces
entries.what: A free account gets 5 GPU minutes a day (2 without logging in), and can host 2 ZeroGPU Spaces once the account is over 30 days old with a verified email. Gradio only.
entries.license: Hugging Face Terms; quota resets 24 hours after first use
entries.needs: Atom signs in to Hugging Face with one account. A fit for occasional GPU batch jobs only.

entries.name: YouTube Data API default quota
entries.what: Default quota per project: 10,000 units a day for most calls, and search.list limited to 100 calls a day. Verse falls back to keyless search without a key.
entries.license: Google API Services Terms and YouTube API Services Terms of Service
entries.needs: A Google Cloud project with the YouTube Data API enabled, and its key set by Atom as YOUTUBE_API_KEY.

entries.name: Crossref and OpenAlex scholarly APIs
entries.what: Keyless Crossref (polite pool) and keyless OpenAlex serve research asks before any model call.
entries.license: Crossref metadata is free to reuse (CC0 facts); OpenAlex data is CC0
entries.verified: carried from resources/free.json, pages not re-read

entries.name: AWS Activate Founders
entries.what: Self-funded startups start with $1,000 in Activate credits, up to $5,000 for some. Needs an AWS Builder ID and an AWS account on the paid tier plan, founded in the last 10 years.
entries.license: AWS Promotional Credit Terms and Conditions
entries.needs: Atom creates the Builder ID and links an AWS account (a payment method is required by AWS).

entries.name: Google for Startups Cloud Program
entries.what: Start tier is $2k for a startup founded within 2 years with a working MVP and a plan to seek venture funding; the funded tiers ($200k to $350k) need verifiable Pre-Seed to Series A funding. Credits cover Google first-party services, including Gemini and Gemma, not third-party models.
entries.license: Google Cloud startup program terms; at Google's discretion; business email must match the website domain
entries.needs: Atom applies with a business email on the company domain and a Google Cloud billing account.
entries.note: Only the Start tier fits a bootstrapped company, and only if it plans to raise.

entries.name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
entries.what: Azure credits by stage through Founders Hub.
entries.license: Microsoft for Startups terms
entries.verified: carried from resources/free.json, amounts not re-read

entries.name: NLnet / NGI grants for open source
entries.what: Grants for open-source work (the repo is MIT and public); a proposal is judged on its merits.
entries.license: NLnet call terms: funded work must be released as open source
entries.verified: carried from resources/free.json, call not re-read
entries.needs: Atom writes and submits a proposal.

entries.name: Oracle Cloud Always Free
entries.what: Small always-free virtual machines. Oracle asks for a card on file for identity, so only Atom can do this.
entries.license: Oracle Cloud Free Tier terms
entries.verified: carried from resources/free.json, page not re-read
entries.needs: Atom signs up in person with his own identity. Verse never touches the payment step.

entries.name: Pexels, Pixabay and Unsplash photo APIs
entries.what: Free keys for three photo libraries, each under its own open licence (Pexels, Pixabay Content and Unsplash licences). lib/free-pics.js already has the adapters and the credit lines, and skips a source until its key is set.
entries.license: Pexels License, Pixabay Content License, Unsplash License
entries.verified: carried from lib/free-pics.js, licence pages not re-read
entries.needs: One free key from each, added by Atom as PEXELS_API_KEY, PIXABAY_API_KEY and UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY.

entries.name: TheSportsDB and Flickr API keys
entries.what: Two more picture sources that functions/api/daily-art.js keeps switched off until a key is set: THESPORTSDB_KEY (off until the owner reads its terms) and FLICKR_API_KEY. Neither is used without a key and a licence check on every picture.
entries.license: Each service's own API terms; Flickr's commercial use needs its own approval, so only open-licensed pictures with credit would ever be used
entries.verified: carried from the code comment in daily-art.js, terms pages not re-read
entries.needs: Atom reads both terms pages, then adds THESPORTSDB_KEY or FLICKR_API_KEY only if they allow it.

entries.name: Poly Haven HDRIs, textures and 3D models
entries.what: Every asset is CC0: any use, commercial included, no credit needed, no licence change. Poly Haven asks that the work is not passed off as the buyer's own authorship.
entries.license: CC0 1.0 Universal (assets); the site itself carries ordinary terms

credit.author: Poly Haven
credit.gap: 3D scenes and card backdrops (the shared 3D backdrop)

entries.note: Listed on /credits/ even though no credit is required.

entries.name: Kenney game assets
entries.what: All asset packs are CC0 (public domain): commercial use is fine and attribution is not required; the Kenney logo is not to be reused on its own.
entries.license: CC0 1.0 Universal

credit.author: Kenney
credit.what: CC0 2D and 3D game assets, icons and sounds

entries.note: Listed on /credits/ even though no credit is required.

entries.name: Smithsonian Open Access
entries.what: Millions of images, 3D models and records released as CC0. A third party may still hold trademark, privacy or publicity rights in an item, so each use is checked.
entries.license: CC0 1.0 Universal; Smithsonian Terms of Use

credit.author: Smithsonian Institution
credit.what: CC0 images, 3D models and collection data
credit.gap: card art references, museum and nature knowledge cards

entries.note: Listed on /credits/ even though no credit is required.

entries.name: The Met Open Access
entries.what: Public-domain images and records of the Met collection released as CC0.
entries.license: CC0 1.0 Universal
entries.verified: carried: the credits list already names it (domains/autosalvage.outside.json); the Met page timed out

entries.name: Wikimedia Commons media
entries.what: Millions of files, each with its own licence. Verse uses only files whose licence is CC0, public domain, CC BY or CC BY-SA, with the author and licence line shown (lib/free-pics.js refuses the rest).
entries.license: Per file; the file page names the licence and the author to credit
entries.verified: carried from resources/free.json and lib/free-pics.js, page not re-read

entries.name: Internet Archive public-domain collections
entries.what: Items marked public domain or with a stated open licence may be used; the item page carries the licence. Everything else is left alone.
entries.license: Per item
entries.verified: carried from resources/free.json, page not re-read

entries.name: Cloudflare R2 free storage
entries.what: 10 GB a month of storage on the free tier. It needs switching on in the Cloudflare dashboard, which asks for a payment method, so only Atom does it.
entries.license: Cloudflare R2 pricing terms
entries.verified: carried from resources/free.json, page not re-read
entries.needs: Atom enables R2 in the dashboard.

ended.name: GitHub Models free tier
ended.why: GitHub retired the playground, catalog, inference API and bring-your-own-key.

ended.name: Mistral free API
ended.why: Mistral's billing docs say Free mode has no API access; keys and API use need billing and pay-as-you-go.

ended.name: Cerebras free tier
ended.why: Now a $5, 30-day trial that asks for a verified payment method, with no permanent free tier. Verse never adds a payment method.

ended.name: Hugging Face free monthly inference credit
ended.why: Free accounts get no included Inference Providers credit; only paid plans do.

notEligible.name: Vercel Open Source Program
notEligible.why: Needs the project hosted or planned on Vercel; Verse is on Cloudflare. Applications were also closed.

notEligible.name: Cloudflare Project Alexandria
notEligible.why: Open-source credits for projects that operate solely on a non-profit basis; Verse sells things.
